# Diagnostics no test provokes: one Go-quoted format per line, then
# `# why` no program can reach it. A reachable one has a case in
# sema/testdata/conform instead; a covered one must leave this list (`go test ./sema -conform-update`
# rewrites it, keeping the reasons).
"%s takes %d arguments"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"%s takes 1 argument"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"%s takes a pointer"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"'%s' cannot be an error without the bound '%s: Error' (D4)"  # bodies are checked per instantiation, so a thrown type parameter is always substituted by then
"'%s' cannot be used as a value"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"'%s' does not implement '%s', required by '%s'"  # defensive: the argument's coercion to the trait refuses a type missing any of it first ('so it cannot be used as a ... value')
"'%s' does not implement '%s'; add 'implement %s { ... }' to its declaration"  # defensive: the argument's coercion to the trait refuses the type first ('so it cannot be used as a ... value')
"'%s' does not implement '%s.%s'"  # defensive: the argument's coercion to the trait refuses the type first
"'%s' has no associated type '%s'"  # only after substitution into a generic body, and the bound was checked at the instantiation
"'%s' has no fields to destructure"  # on the error-union path, whose members are errors and so always structs
"'%s' has no static '%s'"  # defensive: a type that is not a struct, enum or sealed trait is refused as a value before its members are looked at
"'%s' is deprecated"  # @deprecated requires its reason (checked on the attribute), so a reasonless one cannot arise
"'%s' is generic; supply type arguments"  # defensive: an uninferable constructor call is refused first ('cannot infer type parameter')
"'%s' is generic; write the type arguments, e.g. '%s<T>.%s(...)'"  # every static the prelude adds to a built-in collection returns that collection, so collectionStatic infers it (D137); a name with no such static gets 'no static function' first
"'%s' is not a struct"  # only derived (synthesized) code constructs through a resolved type
"'%s' is not a value"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"'%s.%s' is ambiguous: declared by traits '%s' and '%s'"  # a concrete type's associated type is only reached through a type parameter, whose ambiguity is refused first (D84)
"'..' only stands inside a list pattern: '[first, ..rest]'"  # the parser refuses the form first
"'@caller_location' applies to plain functions and inherent methods, not to trait implementations or extern functions (D88)"  # std-only: user code is refused first (reserved for the standard library), and std marks neither
"'[...] =' is not index assignment; brackets are for collection literals only (D25)"  # only when the source text is missing, i.e. synthesized code, which never writes brackets
"'[...]' after a value is not indexing; brackets are for collection literals only (D25)"  # only when the source text is missing, i.e. synthesized code, which never writes brackets
"'ioWait' takes two arguments: the descriptor and whether to wait for writing"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"'ioWait()' always suspends and must be awaited: 'await ioWait(fd, write)' (D16)"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"'next()' must return 'Item?', found '%s'"  # an Iterator implementation is checked against the trait first
"a 'lazy' parameter must be a plain 'fun(): T' — no arguments, effects, default or '...' (D90)"  # std-only, after the reserved check: user code is refused first, and std writes only well-formed ones
"a 'test fun' is a top-level helper, not a method"  # the parser refuses `test fun` in a type body; guards ASTs built another way
"a function marked '@caller_location' cannot suspend (D88)"  # std-only, after the reserved check: user code never reaches the suspension pass with the attribute
"a type is not a value"  # the parser refuses the form first
"cannot assign through '?.': there may be nothing to assign to; check for null first, 'if (x != null) x.f = v'"  # defensive: check_safe.go binds every '?.' write (plain, compound, nested, '&') before an assignment target is checked
"cannot infer the type arguments of '%s' from this call; write them, e.g. '%s<T>.%s(...)', or annotate the binding"  # every static the prelude adds to a built-in collection takes an argument of the element type, so the type is inferred or that argument reports its own error first (D137)
"close() of '%s' throws; throwing cleanup is not supported yet"  # Closeable.close is declared non-throwing, so an implementation cannot throw
"extern functions cannot suspend"  # a function in an 'extern "C" { }' block has no body, so nothing in it can suspend
"field '%s' of '%s' is private (M5)"  # needs two modules; conformance cases are one file each
"index %s is out of range for a constant list of length %d (D113)"  # defensive (D113): every indexed read of a constant table the checker lowers is either 'at', answered at compile time, or guarded by its own length test
"invalid float literal"  # the parser refuses the form first
"listAppendText takes a MutableList<u8> and a string"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"listDecodeUtf8Range takes a List<u8> and two positions"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"listRawData takes a list"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"listTouched takes a MutableList"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"method '%s' is a compiler built-in on '%s' and cannot be redeclared"  # only std may extend a built-in type, and std does not redeclare
"methods cannot be used as values; wrap the call in a lambda"  # defensive: every way to name a method as a value is answered earlier ('is a method of', 'is a method: call it')
"module-level '%s' needs an initializer"  # the parser refuses the form first
"no arm of the 'when' matches the constant"  # a 'when' with a value is exhaustive or has an 'else', so a constant subject always meets an arm
"only a module-level function can be 'extern \"C\"'; C calls it by name (D69)"  # the parser refuses `extern "C" fun` in a type body; guards ASTs built another way
"parameter '%s' needs a type"  # the parser refuses the form first
"secretExpose takes the type to copy out: secretExpose<string>(bytes) or secretExpose<List<u8>>(bytes)"  # std-internal intrinsic: only std calls it, and std calls it right
"this conversion is not a constant expression (D113)"  # defensive (D113): before `const fun` (part 4) the evaluator sees only the HIR of constant expressions, whose conversions are numeric or retype a collection
"this operator is not a constant expression (D113)"  # defensive (D113): before `const fun` (part 4) the evaluator sees only the HIR of constant expressions, whose operand types the checker already matched to the operator
"this statement is not a constant expression (D113)"  # defensive (D113): before `const fun` (part 4) the evaluator sees only the HIR of constant expressions, whose blocks hold only initialized temporaries
"trait objects (boxed '%s') are not supported yet in the bootstrap compiler; use a generic bound instead (D9)"  # defensive: a call on a trait-typed receiver takes the trait-object path first
"unsupported expression"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"unsupported operator"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"unsupported pattern"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"unsupported statement"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"unsupported type syntax"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"unsupported unary operator"  # no syntax reaches it: guards an AST node kind the checker does not handle
"variant '%s.%s' does not implement '%s'"  # a variant without the implement is reported at its declaration now (checkSealedVariants), which stops the body checks
"variants of '%s' disagree on the type of '%s'"  # a sealed trait's method has one signature, which every variant's implement must match
"variants of sealed trait '%s' must be declared in the same module as the trait (D12)"  # needs two modules; conformance cases are one file each
